args.command: echo 'HEADS'; git -C /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime rev-parse HEAD; git -C /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'INSTALLED'; sha256sum /usr/local/sbin/zen-ops-update 2>/dev/null || true; grep -n 'zen-ops-funnel\|Reconcile the OPS' /usr/local/sbin/zen-ops-update 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'RUNTIME'; sha256sum /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime/deploy/ubuntu/zen-ops-update 2>/dev/null || true; grep -n 'zen-ops-funnel\|Reconcile the OPS' /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime/deploy/ubuntu/zen-ops-update 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'TIMER'; systemctl show zen-ops-updater.timer -p ActiveState -p SubState -p LastTriggerUSec --no-pager; echo 'SERVICE'; systemctl show zen-ops-updater.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus --no-pager; echo 'UNIT'; test -f /etc/systemd/system/zen-ops-funnel.service && echo FUNNEL_UNIT=PRESENT || echo FUNNEL_UNIT=ABSENT
